title: US House Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker
summary: Jeffries is set to be the first Black speaker of the US House of Representatives when Democrats take control of the chamber next year.

image.caption: Jeffries currently serves as House minority leaderImage: Kevin Dietsch/Getty Images/AFP

blocks.text: Democrats in the US House of Representatives on Wednesday nominated Hakeem Jeffries to be the next speaker.
Jeffries, who represents a district in New York, would be the first Black person to fill the role. He received 251 out of 265 ballots cast in a closed-door, secret vote.
Hakeem will begin his tenure as speaker in January, when Democrats take the majority in the chamber.
Democrats won the House and the US Senate during the midterms earlier this month in a rebuke of US President Donald Trump's Republican Party.
